auth.name: Name
auth.loginSubtitle: Access your household and get back to the shared inventory in one step.
auth.registerSubtitle: Create your access and leave the household ready from the first launch.
auth.loginAsideBody: Inventory, receipts and prices all belong to the same household, so what you note down shows up on every device in the house.
auth.registerAsideBody: You can create the household now or leave it for later — the app will ask when it needs one.
auth.householdHint: Optional. Fill it now to create your initial household.
auth.emailHint: The one you signed up with. We use it to identify you, not to write to you.
auth.emailHintRegister: This will be your username. It stays on your server — Stoky sends no email.
auth.passwordHintLogin: The one you chose when you created the account. It is case sensitive.
auth.rememberMeHint: Tick it on home devices you use every day, such as the kitchen screen. Unticked, the session ends when you close the browser or after 15 minutes without use.
auth.passwordHintRegister: At least {min} characters. Pick something you can remember: there is no email recovery.
auth.nameHint: How you will appear to the rest of the household. A first name is enough.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts from this connection. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.accountTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts with this account. Wait a few minutes; if it keeps happening, tell whoever runs your household.
auth.authUnavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.loginError: Signing in did not work. Try again in a moment.
auth.registerError: The account could not be created. Check the details and try again.
auth.passwordContainsIdentity: The password contains your name or your email address. Choose one that does not include them.
auth.registrationClosed: Registration is closed on this server. Ask whoever runs your household to add you from “People in the household”, in Settings.
auth.registrationClosedBody: On this server, new accounts are created by whoever runs the household. Ask them to add you from “People in the household”, in Settings.
auth.invalidCredentials: The email or the password is not right. Check both; the password is case-sensitive.
auth.emailExists: There is already an account with this email. Sign in with it, or use another one.
auth.twoFactorInvalidCode: The code is not right, or it has already been used. Enter the one your authenticator app shows now.
auth.twoFactorExpired: The code check has expired or had too many tries. Enter your password again.
auth.twoFactorLocked: Too many wrong codes for this account. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
auth.twoFactorUnreadable: This server cannot check your authenticator app's code. Use a recovery code, or ask whoever runs the household for help.
auth.totpHint: The 6 digits your authenticator app shows now. They change every 30 seconds.
auth.backupCodeTitle: Sign in with a recovery code
auth.backupCodeHint: One of the codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification. Each one works once; capitals, spaces and dashes make no difference.
auth.backupCodeInvalid: The recovery code is not right, or it has already been used. Try another of the ones you saved.
auth.passkeyFailed: Signing in with the passkey did not work. Try again, or sign in with your password.
auth.passkeyNotFound: This passkey is not registered with Stoky at this address, or it has been removed. Sign in with your password.
auth.passkeyNotVerified: The passkey did not check that it was you: the device must ask for your fingerprint, face or PIN. Turn that on in the device, or sign in with your password.
auth.stepUpRequired: For your security, enter your password again before changing your passkeys.

products.addFirst: Create the first one or scan its barcode.

new.title: New product
new.intro: Add a product to your household catalogue. Only the name is required; you can fill in the rest later.
new.scanContextIntro: You are creating the product for this code. It was not in your household yet, so tell us at least what it is called.
new.nameHint: What you call it at home. For example: Whole milk.
new.barcodeHint: The number printed under the bars. Leave it blank if the product has none, or you do not have it to hand.
new.barcodeTakenBy: You already have “{name}” with this barcode. Change the code or leave it blank: two products in the same household cannot share one.
new.lookupHint: We can check the public Open Food Facts catalogue. If it knows this code, we will create the product with its name, brand and category. If it does not know it, no problem: fill the form in by hand and save.
new.lookupButton: Look up in Open Food Facts
new.lookupNotFound: Open Food Facts does not know this code. Fill the form in by hand and save; the product will be created all the same.
new.lookupFailed: We could not reach Open Food Facts. You can carry on by hand and save without waiting, or try again.
new.brandHint: Who makes it. For example: Pascual.
new.categoryHint: Used to group similar products together. For example: Dairy.
new.unitHint: How it is usually measured. For example: kg, L or pack. Leave it as it is to count it in units.
new.minStockHint: The amount below which you want us to warn you. Leave it blank for no warning.
new.errorTitle: The product could not be created
new.errorUnitRequired: Enter the unit, for example kg or pack.
new.errorMinStockInvalid: Minimum stock has to be a number of zero or more, or be left blank.
new.errorBarcodeTaken: That barcode already belongs to “{name}”. Change the code or leave it blank.
new.errorBarcodeTakenServer: That barcode already belongs to another product in your household: someone may have created it while you were filling this form in. Change the code or leave it blank and save again.
new.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one, or ask to be invited, before creating products.
new.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
new.successCreated: “{name}” is now in your household catalogue.
new.successCreatedFromLookup: “{name}” is now in your household catalogue, created from Open Food Facts data.

detail.errorTitle: This product could not be shown
detail.errorNotFound: This product is not in your household's catalogue. It may have been deleted, or the link may point somewhere else. Go back to the list and pick it from there.
detail.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one, or ask to be invited, before viewing products.
detail.errorGeneric: We could not load the product. Try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
detail.stockEmpty: There is none of this product left.
detail.locationsEmpty: There are no stock movements for this product yet.
detail.locationsNote: Some counts need a check. Past uses did not say which batch they came from.
detail.expiryEmpty: No batch of this product has an expiry date.
detail.expiryNote: If the consumed batch was not recorded, its quantity remains unconfirmed.
detail.pricesCaption: Latest recorded prices for this product
detail.pricesEmpty: There are no recorded prices for this product yet.
detail.actionsHint: The stock forms cover the whole catalogue: you will need to pick “{name}” from the product list.
detail.deleteHint: Administrators only, and only when no price, receipt or list still uses it. It is a real delete: no bin, no undo.
detail.deleteBlockedHistory: It cannot be deleted: it has history (stock, prices, receipts or lists), and history is kept. Leave it at zero and it stays as archived.
detail.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. If a price, receipt or list still uses it, it will not be deleted and nothing will be lost.
detail.deleteConflict: It cannot be deleted: prices, receipt lines or list items still use it.
detail.deleteFailed: It could not be deleted. Try again.
detail.deletedBody: “{name}” is no longer in the catalogue.

scan.title: Scan barcode
scan.lookupFailed: The code {barcode} could not be looked up. Scan it again or type it below.
scan.lookupThrottled: You have looked up a lot of new codes in a short time. Fill in product {barcode} by hand; looking codes up will work again shortly.
scan.framingHint: Hold the barcode inside the frame
scan.cameraErrorTitle: The camera could not be used

scan.cameraNotFound: No camera was found on this device. Type the code below.
scan.cameraBusy: Another app is using the camera. Close it and try again.
scan.cameraErrorUnknown: The browser did not say why.
scan.cameraErrorHint: Check in your browser settings that this site may use the camera and reload the page, or type the code below.
scan.insecureContext: The camera only works over a secure connection. Open the app through an https:// address (or localhost) and try again.
scan.torchFailed: The torch would not turn on. Another app may be using the camera — close it and try again.
scan.foundExisting: You already had “{name}” in the catalogue
scan.createdFromLookup: You created “{name}” from Open Food Facts data
scan.queuedOffline: No signal: we saved barcode {barcode} and will resolve it when you reconnect

history.intro: Every movement that explains today's number: purchases, consumptions, adjustments and transfers.

adjust.title: Adjust stock
adjust.intro: Correct the number when what is at home does not match what is noted. It is saved as an adjustment, with its reason.
adjust.actualHint: Count what you can see and write the total, in {unit}.
adjust.reasonHint: Why it did not match. For example: an egg broke, pantry recount.
adjust.errorTitle: The adjustment could not be saved
adjust.errorActualInvalid: Write how much is actually there: a number of zero or more.
adjust.errorReasonRequired: Write the reason for the adjustment.
adjust.errorSame: It already matches what is noted: the adjustment would change nothing.
adjust.errorNotFound: This product is not in your household's catalogue. It may have been deleted, or the link may point somewhere else. Go back to the list and pick it from there.
adjust.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet.
adjust.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
adjust.errorStockChanged: The amount changed while you were counting. Check the new amount and confirm again.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.filterRestockEmpty: Nothing is running low right now.

picker.noProducts: No product matches your search. Try different words, or create the product first.

add.title: Add stock
add.intro: Record what you have just brought home. Pick the product, say how much it is and, if you like, when it expires and where you put it.
add.productSelectHint: Choose the product you want to add stock to.
add.quantityHint: How much you are adding, in the unit below. For example: 2.
add.unitHint: How it is measured. For example: kg, L, pack.
add.expirationHint: Leave this blank if the product does not expire.
add.locationHint: Where you keep it, for example the fridge or the pantry.
add.notePlaceholder: For example: it was on offer
add.noteHint: To remind you of something about this entry: the brand, the offer, or who brought it.
add.errorTitle: The stock could not be added
add.errorProductRequired: Choose a product from the list.
add.errorQuantityRequired: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
add.errorUnitRequired: Enter the unit, for example kg or pack.
add.errorUnitMismatch: This unit cannot be converted to the product's unit ({unit}). Enter the quantity in {unit}.
add.errorExpirationInvalid: That expiry date is not valid. Use the date picker.
add.errorProductNotFound: That product no longer exists. Pick another one from the list.
add.errorLocationNotFound: That location no longer exists. Choose another one, or leave it without a location.
add.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one or ask to be invited before adding stock.
add.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
add.storeHint: Where you bought it. With a store and a price, it lands in the price history.
add.priceHint: What you paid in total for this quantity.
add.errorPriceInvalid: The price has to be more than zero, or be left blank.
add.errorPriceNeedsStore: To record the price, choose the store as well.
add.advancedSummary: More details: unit, location and note

consume.title: Record use
consume.intro: Record what has been used. Pick the product, see how much is left and say how much you used.
consume.availableNoProduct: Choose a product to see how much is left.
consume.availableUnknown: We could not check how much is left. You can carry on, but check the amount before you save.
consume.quantityHint: How much you used, in the unit below. It cannot be more than what is left.
consume.unitHint: How it is measured. For example: kg, L, pack.
consume.locationHint: Where you took it from, for example the fridge or the pantry.
consume.noteHint: To remind you what it went into: a recipe, a meal, or who took it.
consume.errorTitle: The use could not be recorded
consume.errorProductRequired: Choose a product from the list.
consume.errorQuantityRequired: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
consume.errorUnitRequired: Enter the unit, for example kg or pack.
consume.errorUnitMismatch: This unit cannot be converted to the product's unit ({unit}). Enter the quantity in {unit}.
consume.errorNotEnoughStock: There is not that much. Only {available} {unit} of this product are left. Enter that amount or less, or add stock first.
consume.errorNotEnoughStockServer: There is no longer enough of this product: someone in your household used it while you were filling in the form. Go back to the inventory to see what is left, then try a smaller amount.
consume.errorProductNotFound: That product no longer exists. Pick another one from the list.
consume.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one or ask to be invited before recording what is used.
consume.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
consume.productSelectHint: Choose the product that has been used.
consume.advancedSummary: More details: unit, location and note

locations.title: Storage locations
locations.intro: Locations say where you keep each thing. One can sit inside another: “Fridge”, and inside it “Vegetable drawer”.
locations.name: Location name
locations.parentHint: Pick the location that holds it, or leave it as it is if it sits inside nothing.
locations.addFirst: Create the first one and you can start saying where you keep each thing.
locations.readOnly: Only a household admin can change the locations.
locations.deleteFailed: “{name}” could not be deleted. It still holds something: other locations, or stored items.
locations.deleteFailedUnknown: “{name}” could not be deleted. Try again.

hub.title: Settings
hub.intro: This is where you adjust how Stoky organises your household's things.
hub.locationsDescription: Say where you keep things: the fridge, the pantry, the garage, and the shelves that hang off them. You can create them, rename them and move them.
hub.storesDescription: Register the stores you shop at. They are used to record prices and to assign the receipts you scan.
hub.preferencesDescription: The language and how long messages stay are saved on your account, so they follow you to any device you sign in on. The theme is saved in this browser, because it depends on the screen you are looking at.
hub.exportDescription: Everything this household has, in one file: products, stock, receipts, prices and lists. It is yours and you can take it whenever you like.
hub.exportFailed: The file could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.
hub.exportImagesNote: Receipt photographs are not inside the file, only where they live. To keep them, copy the server's uploads folder too.
hub.exportPrivacyNote: The archive contains the names and emails of everyone who uses this household. Keep it somewhere safe.

settings.snackbarDurationHint: It is also how long you have to undo: 10, 30 or 60 seconds.

errors.boundaryBody: The fault is in the application, not in what you were part-way through: nothing you noted down has been lost. Try again, and if it keeps happening go to the start and come back from there.
errors.boundaryReferenceHint: That code is in the server log too, in case whoever runs the household needs to look it up.

household.noHouseholdTitle: You do not have a household yet
household.noHouseholdBody: A household is where the inventory, the shopping list and the prices live. Create yours to get started; you can rename it later.
household.nameHint: Whatever you call it at home. “Home” works perfectly well.
household.createFailed: The household could not be created. Try again.
household.loadFailedTitle: The data could not be loaded
household.loadFailedBody: The connection may have dropped for a moment. Try again.
household.peopleDescription: Who can get in, and what each of them can do.
household.peopleIntro: Household accounts are created here. The kitchen account is for the tablet: it can look at the inventory, record what is used and add things to the shopping list.
household.roleMemberHint: Can add stock, record what is used, manage the list and create products.
household.roleKitchenHint: Can look, record what is used and add things to the shopping list. Meant for a tablet in the kitchen.
household.addPasswordHint: At least {min} characters. They can change it after signing in, from Settings.
household.addDone: Account created for “{name}”. They can sign in with that address now.
household.addEmailTaken: That address already has an account. Use another.
household.addFailed: The account could not be created. Try again.
household.addTooMany: You have created accounts or set passwords too many times in the last hour. Wait a while and try again.
household.addPasswordIdentity: The password contains that person's name or email address. Choose one that does not include them.
household.addPasswordTooEasy: That password is too easy to guess. Choose a longer or less common one.
household.roleFailedLastOwner: The household would have no owner. Make somebody else an owner before changing this.
household.roleFailedNotOwner: Only an owner may change who owns this household.
household.roleFailed: The role could not be changed. Try again.
household.removeConfirmBody: Their account is not deleted: they stop belonging to this household and are signed out on every device.
household.removeDone: {name} no longer belongs to this household.
household.removeFailedLastOwner: The household would have no owner. Make somebody else an owner before removing this one.
household.removeFailedNotOwner: Only an owner may remove another owner.
household.removeFailed: They could not be removed. Try again.
household.memberSessionsBody: Ending a session signs this person out of that device the next time it is used. They stay in the household and can sign in again with their password; if you think somebody else knows it, set a new one too.
household.memberSessionsLoadFailed: Their sessions could not be read. Try again.
household.revokeFailedNotOwner: Only an owner may end another owner's sessions.
household.revokeFailed: Their sessions could not be ended. Try again.
household.endAllHouseholdTitle: End every session in the household
household.endAllHouseholdIntro: Signs everybody in the household out of every device, you on this one too. Use it if somebody who should not have had access got into an account or kept hold of a device. Nobody loses their data or their password: each person signs in again with their own.
household.endAllHouseholdDialogTitle: End every session in the household?
household.endAllHouseholdDialogBody: Everybody in the household will be signed out on every device, you on this one too. Each of you will sign in again with your password.
household.endAllHouseholdFailedAfter: The household's sessions were ended, but this device did not finish signing out. Reload the page.
household.endAllHouseholdNotOwner: Only an owner may end every session in the household.
household.resetBody: For when they have forgotten theirs, or you think somebody else knows it. Every session they have ends, on every device, their passkeys are removed, and they will sign in with the password you type here.
household.resetPasswordHint: At least {min} characters, without their name or email address. Give it to them in person.
household.resetTooShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
household.resetTooEasy: That password is too easy to guess. Choose a longer or less common one.
household.resetFailedNotOwner: Only an owner may set another owner's password.
household.resetTooMany: You have created accounts or set passwords too many times in the last hour. Wait a while and try again.
household.resetFailed: The password could not be changed. Try again.
household.resetDone: {name}'s password is set, their sessions have ended and their passkeys are removed. Give it to them and ask them to change it in Settings as soon as they sign in.
household.removeTwoFactorBody: For when they have lost the phone with their authenticator app and have no recovery codes left. Every session they have ends, and they will need to set it up again; until then they sign in with their password alone. Enter yours to confirm.
household.removeTwoFactorDone: {name}'s two-step verification has been removed and their sessions have ended. Ask them to set it up again as soon as they sign in.
household.removeTwoFactorNotOwner: Only another owner may remove an owner's two-step verification.
household.removeTwoFactorChanged: This person no longer has two-step verification on, or their account changed. The list has been updated.

session.signOutClean: This will sign you out on this device. Nothing is waiting to be sent.

session.signOutShared: Sign out when you are done if other people use this device.

session.signOutFailedAfter: This device's data was cleared, but the session was not ended. Reload the page and sign out again.

password.intro: Change it if you think someone else knows it, or if it was chosen by whoever created your account.

password.identity: The new password contains your name or email address. Choose one that does not include them.
password.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
password.failed: It could not be changed. Try again.
password.changedDetail: Your other devices have been signed out. Sign in on them with the new password.

offline.nothingSavedBody: You are offline and this screen had not been saved on the phone. Try again once you have signal.
offline.pending: {count, plural, one {# change not sent yet} other {# changes not sent yet}}
offline.needsSignin: Sign in again to send your changes. None of them are lost.
offline.failed: {count, plural, one {# change was not saved} other {# changes were not saved}}
offline.full: No room for more offline changes. Get a signal to send the ones you have.
offline.unrepresented: Something is wrong with your unsent changes. Get a signal and open the app again.
offline.needsReconciliation: {count, plural, one {# product needs checking} other {# products need checking}}
offline.needsReview: {count, plural, one {# scanned barcode needs a name} other {# scanned barcodes need a name}}
offline.reconcileBody: We could not save the use of {quantity} {unit} of “{name}”. Check what is left and confirm the count.
offline.reconcileHint: Look on the shelf or in the fridge and type what you see. We will set the count to that number.
offline.reconcileFailed: That could not be adjusted. Try again.
offline.reconcileKitchen: This account can look, record what is used and add things to the shopping list, but not correct the amount. Tell somebody who manages the household.
offline.untickedOff: You put “{name}” back on the list
offline.removeWhileSending: “{name}” is being sent; you can remove it in a moment
offline.unsavedDescription: What could not be saved, and what to do about it.
offline.unsavedIntro: Everything you recorded that the server did not accept. Nothing is lost: you can try again, or discard it yourself.
offline.unsavedEmptyHint: Everything you have recorded has been saved.
offline.reasonNeedsReconciliation: There was less than that left. How much is at home needs checking.
offline.reasonNeedsReview: Nobody knows this barcode yet. Give the product a name.
offline.reasonWrongHousehold: It was recorded in a different household.
offline.reasonRefused: The server did not accept it.
offline.reasonInvalid: Something was missing or not valid.
offline.reasonExhausted: It was tried several times and never got through.

offlinePage.title: Offline
offlinePage.heading: There is no connection right now
offlinePage.body: We could not load this screen and it was not saved on the phone. Anything you did offline is still here and will be sent on its own once you have signal again.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.nothingUrgent: Nothing is about to go off
kitchen.nothingUrgentHint: Everything in the house lasts more than three days.
kitchen.nothingThisWeek: Nothing else goes off this week
kitchen.runningOutFailed: Could not check what is running low.
kitchen.listCreateFailed: The list cannot be created right now. Try again when the connection is back.

snackbar.regionLabel: Notifications (press F8 to reach the notification)
snackbar.undoTooLate: Too late to undo: the change had already been sent.

start.title: Which screen do you want to start on?
start.intro: Pick the one you use most. We will take you there whenever you open the app on this device.
start.shoppingWhat: For the shop: what is missing, scanning, and ticking off what is in the trolley.
start.kitchenWhat: For a tablet at home: what expires soon and what is running out.
start.dashboardWhat: An overview: what needs attention, with a way through to everything else.
start.changeLater: You can change it whenever you like, in Settings.
start.settingsDescription: The screen you arrive at when you open the app on this device. You can choose a different one on other devices.
start.settingsLinkDescription: Choose which screen this device starts on.
start.notChosenYet: You have not chosen on this device yet.
start.kitchenSignIn: If this device is the kitchen screen, sign in on it with “Keep me signed in” ticked. That way it will not ask for the password every time 15 minutes pass without use.

security.title: Security and access
security.hubDescription: See which devices you are signed in on and sign out of any you do not recognise. Change your password and turn on two-step verification.
security.intro: This is where you are signed in. If you do not recognise a device, sign it out.
security.devicesCap: You can have up to 10 sessions open. Signing in an eleventh ends the one unused for longest.
security.endOneBody: That device will have to sign in again with the password.
security.endCurrentBody: You will leave here and have to sign in again.
security.endOthersBody: Every device of yours but this one will be signed out.
security.endAllBody: Every device of yours will be signed out, this one too. You will sign in again on each.
security.endPending: {count, plural, one {# change is unsent} other {# changes are unsent}}. Unless you send them first, they will be lost.
security.endFailedUnsent: Not everything could be sent. No session was ended and your changes are still here. Try again in a few seconds.
security.endFailedAfter: {scope, select, all {The sessions were ended} other {The session was ended on the server}}, but this device did not finish signing out. Reload the page.
security.endedOthers: {count, plural, =0 {There were no other sessions open.} one {# session was ended.} other {# sessions were ended.}}

twoFactorSettings.explainOff: Besides the password, signing in will ask for a code from an authenticator app on your phone. Someone who knows your password then cannot get in without your phone.
twoFactorSettings.explainOn: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app. If you lose your phone, sign in with one of your recovery codes; if you have none either, ask whoever runs the household to remove it.
twoFactorSettings.turnOnBody: Next you will see a QR code to add Stoky to your authenticator app.
twoFactorSettings.scanTitle: Add Stoky to your authenticator app
twoFactorSettings.scanIntro: Scan this QR code with the app on your phone.
twoFactorSettings.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactorSettings.keyLabel: If you cannot scan it, type this key into the app:
twoFactorSettings.openInAppHint: If the app is on this device:
twoFactorSettings.codeHint: The 6 digits it shows now. This checks that the app is set up right.
twoFactorSettings.codeMissing: Enter the 6 digits the app shows.
twoFactorSettings.verifyRefusedTitle: It could not be turned on
twoFactorSettings.verifyFailed: The code could not be checked. Try again.
twoFactorSettings.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, each code lets you in once. Keep them somewhere safe: they cannot be shown again.
twoFactorSettings.copyFailed: They could not be copied. Select them and copy them by hand.
twoFactorSettings.fileHeading: Stoky recovery codes. Each one works only once.
twoFactorSettings.regenerateBody: The ones you have now will stop working.
twoFactorSettings.turnOffBody: The password alone will sign you in, and your recovery codes will stop working.
twoFactorSettings.changedRegenerated: You have new recovery codes. The old ones no longer work.
twoFactorSettings.reviewDevices: If someone else could get into your account, also sign out any sessions you do not recognise.
twoFactorSettings.alreadyEnabled: It had already been turned on elsewhere. The page has been updated.
twoFactorSettings.notEnabled: It had already been turned off elsewhere. The page has been updated.
twoFactorSettings.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to make this change.

reauth.passwordHint: The one you sign in with. It is asked so that nobody holding one of your devices can do this.
reauth.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
reauth.failed: That could not be done. Try again.
